note: EDITED by the script editor / line producer; the screenwriter's draft is shots_ep1_draft.json. Shot ids were renumbered; draft_id is on every shot.

classes.A: any shot in which a named character's face is read, and the two wound inserts; final tier at 100 % scale
classes.B: wides, crowds, driving, environment, prop and hand inserts with no face; final tier at 75 %
classes.C1: drawn 2D full frame or reuse of rendered frames; no Cycles render
classes.C2: re-uses the hook's jaw / gauge macro staging (S08, S09); final tier 75 %, 4 spp

X1.what: v11 expressway, the hook's rescue zone as built (wreck, rescue truck, work lamp, jam, skyline). Dressing for SCENE 02: one hatchback's lamps on an alarm rhythm, a window-glass burst.

X1s.what: X1 plus the overturned sedan 40 D behind the truck, out of the hook cameras' view (to be checked against S03-S05, S24). `V.car` sedan rolled onto its side, shot from the roof and windscreen side only: no underside is built.

X2.what: The same deck 150 D further on: a `truck6` box truck slewed across the three lanes (bevel pass, hazards), the stair gate and one lamp at the left barrier, a taxi with a smashed window against the rescue truck's left side, the rescue truck placed here with its lights on its root.

X2c.what: The rescue truck's exterior as a hero: an opening crew door (`split_door`), see-through glass onto the cab shell, a light bar that can go dark, the body rocking on its root. It never drives in an exterior shot.

CAB.what: Rescue truck crew cab interior: two front seats, rear bench, console with the siren switch, streaked windows, roof raised so seated puppets keep full size; the equipment wall behind the bench (roll shutter, one code-drawn shelf texture, four real props). The shell and camera travel along the shoulder in two shots.

UND.what: Service stair (barrier gap, gate, one flight-and-landing module instanced on a pier) and the street under the expressway reduced to what the dark shows: wet ground, puddles, rain curtains at the deck edges, one far sodium lamp, parked-car silhouettes. Piers and slab underside exist.

RIV.what: Riverside hospital seen through its gate: lit facade (tower window textures), wall, sliding gate of bars with chain, booth light, plain lit cross, river plane with object index 1, a street stub with one lamp. People inside are silhouettes of the extras.

SITE.what: Building site: corrugated hoarding with a bent panel, a bare concrete hall (floor, six columns, slab, puddles), the frame outside as a silhouette. Same file as RIV.

2D.what: Drawn full frame in SVG and composited in the conform: the watch (four states), phone screens (map, lock, incoming, call, lost), black, end card.

kong_wet.what: exists; add the wristwatch, the crowbar on the pack and in two hands

extras.what: exists (10 roles); the green rider is taken out of the set

crew_bitten / crew_dying / crew_infected.what: new variants of `crew_wet`: wound on the side the hook's final S21-S24 show, three grey steps, the driver's eyes and jaws

infected(extras).what: new transform (skin, eyes, torn cloth, claw hands) on the ten roles, plus a silhouette mode; at most twelve distinct figures in a frame

james_wet.what: new, from `crew` proportions and the rider outfit; helmet, no delivery box in EP.1

praew_wet.what: new: bun, coat layer, stethoscope, blue gloves; to be measured on the sheet first

tos_wet / tos_torn.what: new, from `driver` proportions; glasses, navy jacket; the tear and cut tied to the anatomical left forearm

guard.what: new minor: cap, pale blue shirt, torch

survivor run.what: about 2.4 m/s, planted, for Kong, Praew, Tos, James

infected sprint.what: about 3.4 m/s, side-on, forward lean, phase offsets

roof run and jump down.what: James and the junior; planted on roof points from `F.top`

support walk.what: Kong walking the junior (two figures locked at the shoulder)

stairs down.what: walk with one tread of drop per step; wide shot only

slam loop.what: three drawings on twos, hands on steel or glass

crowd waist-up run.what: bob and arm swing for figures whose feet are hidden by cars
